name: Elisabad
title: A Gadite warrior in David's army
summary: Elisabad was one of the brave Gadite warriors who joined David while he was at the stronghold in the wilderness, before he became king over all Israel. The Gadites were known for their military skill and are described as men with faces like lions and swift as gazelles on the mountains. Elisabad is mentioned in the list of Gad's sons who came to David in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: The Gadites join David
keyEvents.description: Elsabad was among the brave Gadite warriors who crossed the Jordan and joined David at the fortress in the wilderness while David was still fleeing from King Saul.

keyEvents.title: Description of the strength of the Gadites
keyEvents.description: The Gadites, including Elzabad, are described as skilled warriors with shields and spears, their faces like lions and swift as gazelles on the mountains.

keyEvents.title: Elzabad's ranking among the Gadites
keyEvents.description: Elzabad is mentioned as the ninth among the Gadite warriors who came to David, in a list of eleven brave men from the tribe of Gad.

keyEvents.title: The Gadites cross the Jordan during flood season
keyEvents.description: These Gadite warriors showed extraordinary courage by crossing the Jordan River in the first month when it overflowed all its banks and drove out everyone in the valleys.

keyEvents.title: David's growing army
keyEvents.description: Elzabad and the other Gadites joining David were part of a larger movement where more and more warriors from various tribes in Israel joined David at Ziklag and Hebron.
